257)༄༅/rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i rus sbyong bya tshul rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhugs/na mo gu ru bh+yaḥmatshan gyi gling bu snyan pa'i nga

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i rus sbyong bya tshul rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhugs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ mtshan gyi gling bu snyan pa'i ngag /rna ba'i bcud du son ma thag /ngan 'gro'i rgyud rnams ming gi mthar// bsal mdzad rdo rje sems der bsngags// zab lam mchog des lnga lam du// 'khyams pa'i nyam thag sems can rnams// ngan song rgyu 'bras sbyong ba'i tshul// 'jug bde'i lag len snying por dril// de la 'dir gshin po gang la bya ba'i spur chog 'di nyid kyi bsregs sbyangs legs par grub pa'i rus bu rnams/ badz+ra saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: zhes pas bsdu zin pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gzhung mthun dang*/ khrus bum rdzas snod rnams kyang 'du bya/ de la cho ga spros pa rgyas pa'i lugs ltar na/ tshig bdun brgyud 'debs/ bsang chu/ dkar bgegs/ tshogs bsags/ mchod rlabs/ bdag bskyed*/ mdun bskyed*/ las sbyor/ bum bsnyen/ bshags pa/ yi rang sogs/ dam bca'/ skong chen lnga/ dag gyur/ bdag 'jug gam/ rig me/ gnang ba nod/ khrus chog rten bskyed/ 'gugs pa/ zhi sbyang phyed ma/ drag sbyang*/ til sbyang*/ lha khrus/ dug khrus/ phyin drug rjes/ rus bu'i steng du zla ba la= sogs dang*/ yig brgya la/ da ha sbyar ba 'bum phrag gcig 'gro dgos pas de la thun gzung*/ thun mthar/ 'dod chags zhe sdang= sogs/ mchog gsum dug sbyong*/ 'byung bzhi/ phyag 'tshal/ dbang bzhi yan/ rjes mchog mchod rlabs/ mchod bstod/ bshags brten/ bsdu ldang*/ dge ba 'di yis= rdo rje 258) sems dpa'= sogs bya'o/ phyi chog bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ skong ba yan/ gsol ka tshogs bsgral bstab/ drang ba/ cha gsum/ bdag 'jug gnang ba nod*/ rten bskyed nas/ phyin drug khrus yan/ rus bu'i= sogs dmigs pa dang*/ bzlas pa thun gzung*/ thun mthar/ dug sbyong nas/ dbang yan/ zas gtad/ lam bstan/ sbrang bsregs/ bzag spyod/ gdod nas lhun grub = lhag ma/ gsol ka bskyang*/

chad brten/ mchod bstod/ bshags brtan/ bsdu ldang bsngo smon/ shis brjod bcas bya'o/ bzlas pa grangs tshad grub nas gzhung gsal sats+tsha btab/ ༈ rab gnas rgyas pa bya ba'i tshul yang*/ cho ga bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bsnyen mthar/ las bum du skad cig= sogs/ dang*/ sngags brgya/ lha 'od du zhu ba= sogs/ ye shes sku mchog= nas/ skong ba yan/ bdag 'jug rgyas par blang*/ gnang ba nod/ gnas lung ltar/ zhi sbyor phyed ma/ drag sbyang*/ til sbyang*/ lha khrus rgyas par bya/ a mṛ ta= sogs rten bskyed/ sa ma ya dzaḥ ma lus sems can= dzaḥhūm̐= med par thim/ bar dang*/ dbang skur cha tshang*/ dbang lhas dbang*/ dbu rgyan/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ mig dbye/ bdag bskyed mchod bstod/ bskyed pa'i lha= 'dir ni rten dang= su pra= ye dhar= brgya tsam/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i = bdag bskyed/ mchod bstod/ bkra shis rgyas parabya/ gsol ka tshogs skong rgyas par bya/ ༈ sa sgrub dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum 259)bsnyen mthar/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i= sogs/ gzhung gsal/ mchod bstod/ bzlas dmigs mthar/ satwa dang*/ yig brgya la/ da ha= tshe las= sogs/ sbyar ba 'bum gnyis 'gro bar bya/ dpag med nam mkha'= dang*/ bla ma dpal ldan= gyis mchod bstod/ dpal ldan rdo rje= ma rnyed yongs su= mchod bstod lha dang*/ ye shes sku mchog= nas/ skong ba yan/ mchod rlabs/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ dge bsngo/ phyi chog 'don lugs de ltar la/ skong ba mthar/ gsol ka tshogs/ cha gsum/ bdag 'jug lhag ma/ gtor 'bul/ chad brtan man mthar dbyung ngo*/ ༈ spros pa shin tu bsdus pa rgyun khyer la brten pa'i sprul sku zhabs drung tshang gi lugs ltar na/ gzhung gsal rus bu bsdu ba dang*/ khrus bum rdzas snod bsham/ rgyun khyer bsnyen pa gsol gdab rjes/ rus bu'i steng du zla ba= sogs yig brgya dang*/ da ha= sbyar bas bkru/

thun mthar/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya/ sats+tsha gdab chog gzhung dang*/ rab gnas mkhyen brtse'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin bya/ sa sgrub dngos/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa gsol btab rjes/ mkhyen brtse'i gsung ltar bsgrub/ thun mthar/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ shis brjod bcas rgyun khyer ltar bya'o/ bsgrubs zin pa'i sats+tsha gang zag mchog rnams la rten gyi nang du gzhug phal pa rnams chu bo chen po'i gzhung du dor ba'am/ sa dpal legs par sba'o/ zab lam cho ga 'di nyid kyis/ 260) /rjes su bzung ba'i dus 'das rnams// thar pa'i lam bzang ma rnyed na// gzhan gyis mi 'grub nges pa ste/ gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho yi// rtse mor gyur rnams zab pa'i phyir// sgrib sbyong yi ge brgya pa las// lhag par rgyal bas ma gsungs so// de phyir rab dkar dge tshogs ma dros klung*// rnam mkhyen rin chen 'byung gnas bskyil ba las// mtha' yas skye rgu'i 'dod ster rol pa can// gzhan phan klu mchog rgyal bzhin 'grub gyur cig zhes pa'ang bsam gtan chos kyi grags pa'i bzhed ngor mang du thos pa'i sngags btsun dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge// bkra shis//
